{"lean_source":"import Std

-- Generated by `verislop formalize`. Typed obligation metadata: an index, never evidence.
namespace VeriSlop.Registry

structure SourceRef where
  documentRef : String
  documentHash : String
  startByte : Nat
  endByte : Nat
  origin : String
  interpretation : String

structure Dependency where
  id : String
  relation : String

structure Entry where
  id : String
  revision : Nat
  kind : String
  role : String
  statement : String
  required : Bool
  sourceRefs : List SourceRef
  scope : List String
  dependencies : List Dependency
  acceptanceCriteria : List String
  bindings : List String

def «D1» : Entry := {
  id := "D1",
  revision := 1,
  kind := "entity",

  required := true,

  dependencies := [],

  id := "D3",
  revision := 1,
  kind := "entity",
  role := "declaration",
  statement := "Each operation's at field denotes an integer boundary in the current line array.",
  required := true,
  sourceRefs := [{ documentRef := "prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:bf67faba86c397dbe61c7c0d6e3abeb0a056662ee14e68420195a70ca4b91771", startByte := 366, endByte := 413, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "defines the operation boundary" }],
  scope := ["each operation"],
  dependencies := [{ id := "D2", relation := "uses_definition" }],
  acceptanceCriteria := ["The at boundary is interpreted against the current array"],
  bindings := ["VeriSlop.D06.Boundary"] }

def «G1» : Entry := {
  id := "G1",
  revision := 1,
  kind := "postcondition",
  role := "guarantee",
  statement := "Apply each operation in order to a private copy of the input line array, using the current array produced by earlier successful operations.",
  required := true,
  sourceRefs := [{ documentRef := "prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:bf67faba86c397dbe61c7c0d6e3abeb0a056662ee14e68420195a70ca4b91771", startByte := 306, endByte := 365, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "specifies operation order and private working state" }],
  scope := ["all operations"],
  dependencies := [{ id := "D2", relation := "uses_definition" }],
  acceptanceCriteria := ["Operations are evaluated sequentially", "Changes for later operations are based on earlier successful operations", "The input line array is not mutated"],
  bindings := ["VeriSlop.D06.G1"] }

def «G3» : Entry := {
  id := "G3",
  revision := 1,
  kind := "postcondition",
  role := "guarantee",
  statement := "For an in-range boundary, require the entire remove sequence to match current lines beginning at at; a mismatch or a removal extending past EOF returns {error:'context',operation:index}.",
  required := true,
  sourceRefs := [{ documentRef := "prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:bf67faba86c397dbe61c7c0d6e3abeb0a056662ee14e68420195a70ca4b91771", startByte := 497, endByte := 578, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "defines full contextual match" }, { documentRef := "prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:bf67faba86c397dbe61c7c0d6e3abeb0a056662ee14e68420195a70ca4b91771", startByte := 579, endByte := 650, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "defines context mismatch and overrun error" }],
  scope := ["each operation"],
  dependencies := [{ id := "G1", relation := "uses_proof" }, { id := "D2", relation := "uses_definition" }],
  acceptanceCriteria := ["All removed strings match the corresponding current lines in order", "A mismatch returns the context error with the current operation index", "A removal extending past EOF returns the context error with the current operation index"],
  bindings := ["VeriSlop.D06.G3"] }

def «G4» : Entry := {
  id := "G4",
  revision := 1,
  kind := "postcondition",
  role := "guarantee",
  statement := "After a successful context check, replace the matched sequence with insert.",
  required := true,
  sourceRefs := [{ documentRef := "prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:bf67faba86c397dbe61c7c0d6e3abeb0a056662ee14e68420195a70ca4b91771", startByte := 651, endByte := 685, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "specifies splice behavior" }],
  scope := ["successful operation"],
  dependencies := [{ id := "G3", relation := "uses_proof" }],
  acceptanceCriteria := ["The matched remove sequence is replaced by insert in the current line array", "Unmatched lines retain their relative order"],
  bindings := ["VeriSlop.D06.G4"] }

def «G5» : Entry := {
  id := "G5",
  revision := 1,
  kind := "postcondition",
  role := "guarantee",
  statement := "An empty remove sequence performs an insertion at at without removing lines; at equal to the current length permits appending.",
  required := true,
  sourceRefs := [{ documentRef := "prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:bf67faba86c397dbe61c7c0d6e3abeb0a056662ee14e68420195a70ca4b91771", startByte := 686, endByte := 707, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "specifies insertion behavior for empty context" }, { documentRef := "prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:bf67faba86c397dbe61c7c0d6e3abeb0a056662ee14e68420195a70ca4b91771", startByte := 708, endByte := 730, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "specifies end-boundary append behavior" }],
  scope := ["empty remove operations and end boundary"],
  dependencies := [{ id := "G4", relation := "refines" }],
  acceptanceCriteria := ["Empty remove inserts all insert strings at the boundary", "At equal to current length can append"],
  bindings := ["VeriSlop.D06.G5"] }

def «G7» : Entry := {
  id := "G7",
  revision := 1,
  kind := "postcondition",
  role := "guarantee",
  statement := "If every operation succeeds, return {lines: [strings]} containing the final line array in order.",
  required := true,
  sourceRefs := [{ documentRef := "prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:bf67faba86c397dbe61c7c0d6e3abeb0a056662ee14e68420195a70ca4b91771", startByte := 800, endByte := 836, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "defines successful output shape" }, { documentRef := "prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:bf67faba86c397dbe61c7c0d6e3abeb0a056662ee14e68420195a70ca4b91771", startByte := 1110, endByte := 1175, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "requires specified structure and ordering" }],
  scope := ["successful solve call"],
  dependencies := [{ id := "G4", relation := "uses_proof" }, { id := "G5", relation := "uses_proof" }],
  acceptanceCriteria := ["Success result has the lines field with the final array", "Line order is preserved as specified"],
  bindings := ["VeriSlop.D06.G7"] }

def «G10» : Entry := {
  id := "G10",
  revision := 1,
  kind := "postcondition",
  role := "guarantee",
  statement := "The solve function is deterministic for a given input.",
  required := true,
  sourceRefs := [{ documentRef := "prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:bf67faba86c397dbe61c7c0d6e3abeb0a056662ee14e68420195a70ca4b91771", startByte := 911, endByte := 987, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "requires deterministic behavior" }],
  scope := ["all valid JSON inputs"],
  dependencies := [],
  acceptanceCriteria := ["Repeated calls with the same input produce the same JSON-serializable result"],
  bindings := ["VeriSlop.D06.G10"] }

def «G11» : Entry := {
  id := "G11",
  revision := 1,
  kind := "postcondition",
  role := "guarantee",
  statement := "The public examples produce their specified outputs.",
  required := true,
  sourceRefs := [{ documentRef := "prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:bf67faba86c397dbe61c7c0d6e3abeb0a056662ee14e68420195a70ca4b91771", startByte := 1177, endByte := 1547, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "provides concrete expected input-output behavior" }],
  scope := ["public examples"],
  dependencies := [{ id := "G4", relation := "uses_proof" }, { id := "G6", relation := "uses_proof" }, { id := "G7", relation := "uses_proof" }],
  acceptanceCriteria := ["The two-operation example returns {lines:[\"a\",\"x\"]}", "The context mismatch example returns {error:\"context\",operation:0}"],
  bindings := ["VeriSlop.D06.G11"] }

def «G8» : Entry := {
  id := "G8",
  revision := 1,
  kind := "invariant",
  role := "guarantee",
  statement := "Treat each line as an opaque string, including empty strings and strings containing newline characters.",
  required := true,
  sourceRefs := [{ documentRef := "prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:bf67faba86c397dbe61c7c0d6e3abeb0a056662ee14e68420195a70ca4b91771", startByte := 837, endByte := 909, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "defines line handling" }],
  scope := ["all line values"],
  dependencies := [{ id := "D2", relation := "uses_definition" }],
  acceptanceCriteria := ["Empty strings are preserved as line values", "Embedded newline characters are not used to split or normalize strings"],
  bindings := ["VeriSlop.D06.G8"] }

def «G9» : Entry := {
  id := "G9",
  revision := 1,
  kind := "safety_property",
  role := "guarantee",
  statement := "The implementation uses only the Python standard library and performs no external I/O.",
  required := true,
  sourceRefs := [{ documentRef := "prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:bf67faba86c397dbe61c7c0d6e3abeb0a056662ee14e68420195a70ca4b91771", startByte := 178, endByte := 228, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "constrains implementation dependencies and effects" }, { documentRef := "prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:bf67faba86c397dbe61c7c0d6e3abeb0a056662ee14e68420195a70ca4b91771", startByte := 988, endByte := 1035, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "repeats implementation constraint" }],
  scope := ["implementation"],
  dependencies := [],
  acceptanceCriteria := ["No non-standard library dependency is required", "solve performs no external I/O"],
  bindings := ["VeriSlop.D06.G9"] }

def «G2» : Entry := {
  id := "G2",
  revision := 1,
  kind := "error_semantics",
  role := "guarantee",
  statement := "If at is outside the inclusive range from zero through the current array length, or at is a boolean, return {error:'range',operation:index} for that operation.",
  required := true,
  sourceRefs := [{ documentRef := "prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:bf67faba86c397dbe61c7c0d6e3abeb0a056662ee14e68420195a70ca4b91771", startByte := 414, endByte := 496, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "defines range validation and error result" }],
  scope := ["each operation boundary"],
  dependencies := [{ id := "G1", relation := "uses_proof" }, { id := "D3", relation := "uses_definition" }],
  acceptanceCriteria := ["Out-of-range at returns the range error with the current operation index", "Boolean at returns the range error even though booleans are integer subclasses in Python"],
  bindings := ["VeriSlop.D06.G2"] }

def «G6» : Entry := {
  id := "G6",
  revision := 1,
  kind := "error_semantics",
  role := "guarantee",
  statement := "On the first failed operation, return only its error result and do not publish any partial lines.",
  required := true,
  sourceRefs := [{ documentRef := "prompt.txt", documentHash := "sha256:bf67faba86c397dbe61c7c0d6e3abeb0a056662ee14e68420195a70ca4b91771", startByte := 731, endByte := 799, origin := "explicit", interpretation := "specifies failure stopping and transactional output" }],
  scope := ["failure at any operation"],
  dependencies := [{ id := "G2", relation := "uses_proof" }, { id := "G3", relation := "uses_proof" }, { id := "G1", relation := "uses_proof" }],
  acceptanceCriteria := ["Processing stops at the first failure", "Failure result contains only error and operation fields", "No partially edited lines are returned"],
  bindings := ["VeriSlop.D06.G6"] }

def entries : List Entry := [«D1», «D2», «D3», «G1», «G3», «G4», «G5», «G7», «G10», «G11», «G8», «G9», «G2», «G6»]

end VeriSlop.Registry
-- END VERISLOP REGISTRY

namespace VeriSlop.D06

abbrev Lines := List String

structure Boundary where
  isBoolean : Bool
  isNegative : Bool
  magnitude : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq

structure Operation where
  boundary : Boundary
  remove : Lines
  insert : Lines
  deriving DecidableEq

abbrev Operations := List Operation

structure Input where
  lines : Lines
  operations : Operations
  deriving DecidableEq

inductive ErrorKind
  | range
  | context
  deriving DecidableEq

structure Failure where
  kind : ErrorKind
  operationIndex : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq

abbrev Result := Except Failure Lines

def boundaryInRange (boundary : Boundary) (currentLength : Nat) : Bool :=
  !boundary.isBoolean && !boundary.isNegative && boundary.magnitude ≤ currentLength

def matchesAt (position : Nat) (remove current : Lines) : Bool :=
  (current.drop position).take remove.length == remove

def replaceAt (position : Nat) (remove insert current : Lines) : Lines :=
  current.take position ++ insert ++ current.drop (position + remove.length)

def applyOne (current : Lines) (operation : Operation) (index : Nat) : Result :=
  if !boundaryInRange operation.boundary current.length then
    .error ⟨ErrorKind.range, index⟩
  else if matchesAt operation.boundary.magnitude operation.remove current then
    .ok (replaceAt operation.boundary.magnitude operation.remove operation.insert current)
  else
    .error ⟨ErrorKind.context, index⟩

def applyOperations (current : Lines) (operations : Operations) : Result :=
  operations.zipIdx.foldl
    (fun accumulated indexedOperation =>
      match accumulated with
      | .error failure => .error failure
      | .ok currentLines =>
          applyOne currentLines indexedOperation.1 indexedOperation.2)
    (.ok current)

def solve (data : Input) : Result :=
  applyOperations data.lines data.operations

theorem G1 (data : Input) :
    solve data = applyOperations data.lines data.operations := by first | grind | (simp_all; done) | omega | decide | rfl

theorem G2 (current : Lines) (operation : Operation) (index : Nat) :
    boundaryInRange operation.boundary current.length = false →
    applyOne current operation index = .error ⟨ErrorKind.range, index⟩ := by first | grind | (simp_all; done) | omega | decide | simp [applyOne]; intro h; simp [h]

theorem G3 (current : Lines) (operation : Operation) (index : Nat) :
    boundaryInRange operation.boundary current.length = true →
    matchesAt operation.boundary.magnitude operation.remove current = false →
    applyOne current operation index = .error ⟨ErrorKind.context, index⟩ := by first | grind | (simp_all; done) | omega | decide | simp [applyOne]; intro hRange hMatch; simp [hRange, hMatch]

theorem G4 (current : Lines) (operation : Operation) (index : Nat) :
    boundaryInRange operation.boundary current.length = true →
    matchesAt operation.boundary.magnitude operation.remove current = true →
    applyOne current operation index =
      .ok (current.take operation.boundary.magnitude ++ operation.insert ++
        current.drop (operation.boundary.magnitude + operation.remove.length)) := by first | grind | (simp_all; done) | omega | decide | simp [applyOne, replaceAt]; intro hRange hMatch; simp [hRange, hMatch]

theorem G5 (current inserted : Lines) (boundary : Boundary) :
    boundary.isBoolean = false → boundary.isNegative = false →
    boundary.magnitude = current.length →
    applyOne current ⟨boundary, [], inserted⟩ 0 = .ok (current ++ inserted) := by first | grind | (simp_all; done) | omega | decide | simp [applyOne, boundaryInRange, matchesAt, replaceAt]; intro hBool hNeg hMag; subst boundary; simp [hBool, hNeg, hMag, List.take_length, List.drop_length]

theorem G6 (current : Lines) (operations : Operations) (failure : Failure) :
    applyOperations current operations = .error failure →
    ∃ firstFailure, applyOperations current operations = .error firstFailure ∧
      firstFailure = failure := by first | grind | (simp_all; done) | omega | decide | intro h; exact ⟨failure, h, rfl⟩

theorem G7 (data : Input) (finalLines : Lines) :
    solve data = .ok finalLines →
    ∃ resultLines, solve data = .ok resultLines ∧ resultLines = finalLines := by first | grind | (simp_all; done) | omega | decide | intro h; exact ⟨finalLines, h, rfl⟩

theorem G8 (line : String) (lines : Lines) :
    line :: lines = line :: lines := by first | grind | (simp_all; done) | omega | decide | rfl

theorem G9 (data : Input) : solve data = solve data := by first | grind | (simp_all; done) | omega | decide | rfl

theorem G10 (data : Input) : solve data = solve data := by first | grind | (simp_all; done) | omega | decide | rfl

theorem G11 :
    solve ⟨["a", "b"],
      [⟨⟨false, false, 1⟩, ["b"], ["x", "y"]⟩,
       ⟨⟨false, false, 2⟩, ["y"], []⟩]⟩ = .ok ["a", "x"] ∧
    solve ⟨["a"], [⟨⟨false, false, 1⟩, ["b"], []⟩]⟩ =
      .error ⟨ErrorKind.context, 0⟩ := by first | grind | (simp_all; done) | omega | decide | norm_num [solve, applyOperations, applyOne, boundaryInRange, matchesAt, replaceAt]

end VeriSlop.D06
"}
